review: The game looks good: the glowing ghost, the clear red spikes and a new colour for each stage are easy to read on a small screen. But I got stuck too much. In First Steps the mid player stood in front of two spike clusters for 45 seconds, and in Spike Garden nobody got past them at all; I would close the tab there. Ferry Lines and Gauntlet drop almost everyone into pits, and Laser Gate killed the run after 2 seconds. Crumble Bridge and Spring Loaded are the only stages that feel fair and fun. The difficulty jumps up and down with no curve.
best: Crumble Bridge is quick, readable and fair, with a real risk but a finish most players reach.
worst: Spike Garden is stage 2 and nearly nobody can finish it; players just stand at the spikes until the timer ends.
